$sources: NBCC 2020 Appendix C, Table C-2 (climatic design data: ground snow load Ss, associated rain load Sr, hourly wind pressure q1/50) and the seismic hazard values of Appendix C (Sa(T), site class C)
source: NBCC 2020 Appendix C (values to be checked against the printed table: VERIFY.md). windSpeed is the speed whose velocity pressure 0.000613 V² [kPa] is the town's q1/50 (the program's power law takes V; NBCC gives q). spectrum: Sa(T) at 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0 and 10.0 s for site class C, given only where SAEngine had a value; other towns and other site classes: enter the site's Sa(T) from the NRCan 2020 seismic hazard calculator (Site > Mapped spectral values > design spectrum). zone is not used (1 everywhere).

towns.zClause: NBCC 2020 Appendix C (Sa(T) of site class C, where the pack gives them)
towns.windClause: NBCC 2020 Appendix C, Table C-2 (q1/50 as the speed of the same velocity pressure)
towns.governs: the site's own values from the NRCan hazard calculator and Appendix C govern over the nearest town

sources.groundSnow: NBCC 2020 Table C-2, Ss (1-in-50-year ground snow load) [kPa]
sources.rainLoad: NBCC 2020 Table C-2, Sr (associated 1-in-50-year rain load) [kPa]
sources.windSpeed: NBCC 2020 Table C-2, q1/50 [kPa]: Vancouver 0.45, Calgary 0.48, Edmonton 0.45, Winnipeg 0.45, Toronto 0.44, Ottawa 0.41, Montréal 0.42, Québec 0.41, Halifax 0.52; V = √(q / 0.000613)
sources.spectrum: NBCC Appendix C seismic hazard values, site class C (SAEngine entered the 2015 edition's values as remembered: replace with the 2020 values; see VERIFY.md)
